decision.reason: The only upstream evidence is the two install.yaml manifests [ev-782bc47d120d] [ev-c2c6c790d6b2], and their excerpts show nothing beyond "apiVersion: v1". They don't show the HelmRepository v1 schema, the new required constraint under status.artifact, or what happens to existing objects. The claim that "objects that omit them are rejected" comes from the generic computed-diff template, not from upstream text. Because status.artifact.digest is a status field that the controller writes, I'd need the schema diff itself, plus release notes or an upgrade guide saying whether stored objects or controller status updates actually fail, before keeping a mandatory-work resource-rejected consequence or replacing it with another kind.
